Leaflet 1.9.4: https://leafletjs.com/
Distribution files copied from the official npm leaflet@1.9.4 package.
Package SHA-512 integrity verified against npm registry metadata.
BSD license: see LICENSE. Marker images remain beside leaflet.css.

Bundled locally so both the web frontend and Capacitor APK can load the
library without a CDN, API key or billing account. Basemap tiles still
require internet access and compliance with the tile provider's policy.
